scene_description: A young boy in a red and blue soccer uniform is running and about to kick a soccer ball on a green grassy field. Other players can be seen in the background.

questions.question: What do you think will happen after he kicks the soccer ball?
questions.evidence_hint: Imagine what comes next after he kicks it.

questions.question: What do you think he was doing before he ran up to the ball?
questions.evidence_hint: Imagine what happened just before this moment.

questions.question: Have you ever played soccer or kicked a ball outside?
questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you played outside.

questions.question: What other sport could this boy play instead of soccer?
questions.evidence_hint: Imagine a different sport he could try.

questions.question: How do you think this boy feels while he is playing soccer?
questions.evidence_hint: Think about how you would feel running and playing a game.
